toolchain.note: arch-independent (JVM bytecode); same image as teku, digest verified 2026-11-04; we hash the application jar, not the tarball

notes: Verified: the Besu application jar is byte-identical across rebuilders and matches the jar inside Besu's official Docker image. The dist TARBALL wrapper is NOT reproducible (Gradle timestamps; Besu does not set reproducibleFileOrder/preserveFileTimestamps like Teku), so this recipe hashes the app jar. Repo moved to besu-eth/besu for releases after ~26.10; use the clone URL matching the session's project id.
